title: LR + Venn-Abers Calibration: Primary Path to NBA Brier < 0.21
source: Cloud Brain SOTA search + live island observation

sota_findings.paper: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sota_findings.key_technique: LR baseline at 0.199 Brier, XGBoost 0.202. LSTM+MC-dropout achieves best calibrated sequential probabilities.
sota_findings.actionable: Our fleet best 0.22073 vs SOTA 0.199 = 0.022 gap. Primary levers: (1) Venn-Abers/Platt calibration on LR predictions, (2) EWMA rolling sequential features.

sota_findings.paper: Stacked Ensemble Model for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
sota_findings.key_technique: Diverse stacking: NB, AdaBoost, MLP, KNN, XGBoost, DT, LR. CNN achieves 0.221.
sota_findings.actionable: S22 venn_abers_fusion (0.22073) already beats stacking SOTA. MLP meta-learner is next.

S15_nba_evo_6.note: Wide-search GA selected LR as best — no calibration applied yet.

P2_political_alpha_2.note: LR also POL live fleet best — cross-domain confirmation.

proposed_experiments.name: Platt scaling on LR outputs in S15
proposed_experiments.description: Add Platt calibration (sigmoid fit on validation holdout) to LR predict_proba(). Already have isotonic — add 'platt' to CALIBRATION_OPTIONS.
proposed_experiments.implementation: hf-space app.py: in evaluate_individual(), after model.predict_proba(), apply calibrated_clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, cv='prefit', method='sigmoid'). Add 'platt' to CALIBRATION_OPTIONS list.

proposed_experiments.name: Venn-Abers for LR on S15 + S18
proposed_experiments.description: Venn-Abers already runs in S22 (fleet best 0.22073). Port to S15 (LR) and S18 (random_forest). Add venn_abers to CALIBRATION_OPTIONS if not present.
proposed_experiments.implementation: Verify CALIBRATION_OPTIONS in S15/S18 app.py includes 'venn_abers'. If not, add. GA will discover via mutation.

proposed_experiments.name: Expanded EWMA decay grid for sequential features
proposed_experiments.description: Expand rolling_ema feature generation: alpha=[0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3] for last 5/10/20 games on pts/ast/reb/off_rtg/def_rtg. LSTM SOTA (0.199) uses sequential form — we can approximate with EWMA.
proposed_experiments.implementation: features/engine.py: in _compute_rolling_ema(), add alpha variants. Requires parity update to hf-space/features/engine.py.
proposed_experiments.expected_gain: -0.005 to -0.008 Brier with sequential feature enrichment

target_islands: P1 (lightgbm 0.24999 — highest brier, most to gain)
